# AgIsoStack++ in espVT

This directory is based on Open-Agriculture/AgIsoStack-plus-plus commit
`509a920cadff634612e8972158e1c293c9f372c7` and contains local changes required
by the ESP32-S3 virtual terminal.

The local changes include ESP/TWAI reliability fixes, virtual-terminal object
pool processing changes, transport timing adjustments and multi-producer CAN
transmit queue synchronization. The upstream project remains covered by its
own MIT license in this directory.

Upstream: https://github.com/Open-Agriculture/AgIsoStack-plus-plus
